name: Orman's Furniture
old_description: Use our design center to find the right colors for your home. Choose from multiple stain options and wood species.
about:
Orman's Furniture has served Overland Park, Kansas, for over five decades. The retailer operates from a single location on Metcalf Avenue, offering a large open warehouse showroom where customers can browse extensive stock.

The business specializes in solid wood furniture for bedroom, dining room, living room, and office settings. Its inventory emphasizes Amish-crafted collections from makers such as J&R Woodworking and Indian Trail, alongside other American-made lines. Customers can custom-order many pieces, selecting from a range of wood species — including cherry, walnut, hickory, and quarter-sawn white oak — as well as stain colors, genuine and faux leathers, and performance fabrics. An in-store design center allows shoppers to visualize finishes before purchasing.

The company serves residential customers seeking heirloom-quality furnishings, positioning itself as an alternative to national big-box chains. Its showroom operates with immediate availability on many items and offers delivery service.

Orman's frames its value proposition around longevity and personal service, describing itself as "Overland Park's antidote to the out-of-state, big-box stores that promise more than they can deliver." The emphasis on American-made, solid-wood construction and customizable options reflects a focus on durability over disposable trends.
